// diagnostic

E1250

Toolchain channel `{channel}` is pinned but not locked.

What

Toolchain channel `{channel}` is pinned but not locked.

Why

An `--offline`/CI build won't resolve a channel — it needs the exact toolchain version recorded in `.jet/lock`, and none is present (D-JPK-TOOLCHAIN1). Resolving a channel reaches the network, which offline/CI forbids.

Fix

Run `jet update jet` to resolve `{channel}` to an exact version, then commit `.jet/lock`.
